metrics.profile_summary: Customer-focused professional with a background in customer support, team leadership, and B2B sales within the tech and digital services industry. Skilled in lead generation and client lifecycle management with a foundational background in graphic design.

education.institution: Govt Degree Boys College Johar Campus

experience.description: Generates and qualifies leads for digital solutions, pitches and closes B2B deals, and manages CRM records.
Managed shift operations, mentored team members, and handled escalated customer issues to ensure satisfaction.
Provided professional multi-channel support, resolved customer inquiries, and focused on client retention.
Created UI/UX designs, branding materials, and multimedia content for social media and websites.

strengths: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite for asset creation
Strong B2B communication and lead generation skills
weaknesses: No experience with UTM tracking, Meta Business Suite, or content scheduling
Professional trajectory is focused on Sales/Support rather than Marketing
evaluation.summary: The candidate lacks the mandatory educational qualifications and specific social media marketing experience required for the role, despite having useful graphic design skills.
